verdict.rationale: Antigravity documents Scheduled Tasks: you define a cron schedule and agents start and run autonomously in the background. Supporting features include scheduling messages to agents while you're away, headless non-interactive CLI runs for scripting and CI pipelines, background worktree isolation, and hooks at points in the execution loop. Missing for 10: a dedicated in-depth docs page for Scheduled Tasks (the claim comes from a product page), and independent or hands-on corroboration that background scheduled automations work as claimed.
